instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In an indoor boxing gym, the woman in the black tube top (R1) stands in the center, punching a silver double-end bag. The bearded man in the black t-shirt (R2) stands behind her, holding her left hand to guide her form. Cool overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
